lines.text: The field map says exactly where every target is. Real fields are built by people, so the real target is often a few centimeters off.
In our simulator, a robot that drives to the map hits a two centimeter target only fifty seven percent of the time. On a messier field, fifteen.
So when it gets close, our robot stops trusting the map, and measures the target's own AprilTag instead.
Measuring well takes solving three problems. Let's take them one at a time.
